description: Use this when the user wants Deepnia to make a short video: gets its exact price in Deepnia credits before anything is created. Nothing is charged. Reference images keep the exact product/person: give the product photo here. Show the price to the user; once they accept, call create_video with the quote_id and credits it returns: that call makes the video (a quote alone creates nothing).

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio, for example 16:9 or 9:16. Default: the model's default; see list_creation_options.

duration_seconds.description: Length in seconds. Default: the model's shortest.

creation_id.description: The id of a finished image made here with create_image (get_creation, list_my_creations).

url.description: A public https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture, up to 10 MB.

end_image.description: The video ends on this picture, with start_image: { creation_id } or { url }. Models with end_image true in list_creation_options.

mode.description: The model's mode (a quality tier, or the voice of a talking model): settings.modes in list_creation_options. Default: settings.defaultMode.

model.description: Video model id from list_creation_options. Default: Deepnia's default.

prompt.description: What to create, in the user's words.

reference_images.description: Reference images keep the exact product/person: give the product photo here. The video shows them (not as its first frame). Not together with start_image. Each is { creation_id } or { url }; how many each model takes: max_reference_images in list_creation_options.

creation_id.description: The id of a finished image made here with create_image (get_creation, list_my_creations).

url.description: A public https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture, up to 10 MB.

resolution.description: Resolution, for example 720p. Default: the model's default; see list_creation_options.

sound.description: false: no sound, on models with settings.soundSwitch true. Default: sound wherever the model makes it.

creation_id.description: The id of a finished image made here with create_image (get_creation, list_my_creations).

url.description: A public https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture, up to 10 MB.

start_image.description: The video starts from this picture (image-to-video): { creation_id } or { url }. Models with start_image true in list_creation_options.

name: quote_video
title: Price a short video
